text_block_list.text:
Having finished the Osaka Hai, Neo 
Universe expresses her joy in cryptic 
words. Her Trainer understands her meaning 
in an instant.

As if memories from another universe 
flowed into them, connecting their 
hearts... both of them thought. —"If only 
we could keep running together like this."

To help grant her wish, the Trainer 
suggests, "Could it be that it hasn't 
disappeared, but is simply hidden from 
sight?"

The mystery remains unsolved... but every 
measure has been taken. In that case, the 
two need no petty evasions. Towards the 
"GATE"—they push forward to the Tenno Sho 
(Spring).
